priorityList: Maintain Arcane Intellect and ensure your Water Elemental is summoned at all times.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racial abilities immediately after casting Frozen Orb or Ray of Frost.
Cast Flurry if you have a Brain Freeze proc, especially outside of Icy Veins/Thermal Void windows.
Cast Frozen Orb on cooldown to generate Fingers of Frost and Frostfire stacks.
Cast Glacial Spike as soon as you reach 5 Icicles.
Cast Ice Lance whenever Fingers of Frost is active.
Cast Ice Lance if the target has 10 or more stacks of the Freezing debuff.
Cast Flurry if you have a charge available to apply Winter's Chill before a big spell.
Cast Ray of Frost on cooldown, but avoid using it if you have a Frostfire Empowerment proc active.
Cast Frostbolt as your primary filler to generate Icicles and Brain Freeze procs.
Use Ice Lance while moving if you have no procs or other instant-cast abilities available.
